messages.settings.language.label: Language
messages.settings.language.desc: Use your browser language automatically, or choose a language for player.html.
messages.settings.export-config.desc: Download the current configuration as player.html.json
messages.settings.export-manifest.desc: Download a starter manifest.json for hosting next to player.html
messages.library.name: Name
messages.library.noUnfinished: No unfinished media in this library.
messages.openUrl.required: Enter a folder or media URL.
messages.openUrl.failed: Unable to open URL. Check CORS and directory listing support.
messages.subtitle.position.author: Author default
messages.settings.hue.label: Theme color
messages.settings.hue.desc: Set the theme color for player.html, including grayscale values.
messages.settings.blur.label: UI Blur Effects
messages.settings.blur.desc: Enable or disable blur effects in the UI
messages.settings.transitions.label: UI Transitions
messages.settings.transitions.desc: Enable/disable animated transitions in the UI
messages.settings.auto-subtitles.label: Auto-load matching subtitles
messages.settings.auto-subtitles.desc: Automatically load a subtitle file that shares the video filename (e.g. .vtt or .srt).
messages.settings.subtitle-font.label: Subtitle font
messages.settings.subtitle-size.label: Subtitle size
messages.settings.subtitle-position.label: Subtitle position
messages.settings.subtitle-position.desc: Fallback vertical position used only when cues have no authored line setting.
messages.settings.subtitle-color.label: Subtitle color
messages.settings.subtitle-background.label: Subtitle background
messages.settings.subtitle-shadow.label: Text shadow background
messages.settings.subtitle-shadow.desc: Use transparent subtitle backgrounds with a drop shadow offset down and right.
messages.settings.poster-upload.label: Custom poster image
messages.settings.poster-upload.desc: Choose a custom player poster image stored in this browser. Raster images are resized to fit 1920x1080 and encoded as WebP when supported. SVG images remain unchanged.
messages.settings.poster-reset.label: Reset poster image
messages.settings.poster-reset.desc: Clear custom poster image and return to configured/default poster.
messages.settings.wake-lock.label: Prevent screen sleep
messages.settings.wake-lock.desc: Keep the screen awake while audio or video is playing, when supported by the browser.
messages.settings.watch-history.label: Remember playback history
messages.settings.watch-history.desc: Remember playback positions and completion status for recent media.
messages.settings.watch-history-clear.label: Clear playback history
messages.settings.watch-history-clear.desc: Clear remembered playback positions and completion status.
messages.settings.subtitle-reset.label: Reset subtitle settings
messages.settings.subtitle-reset.desc: Reset subtitle-specific settings to their defaults.
messages.settings.thumbnailing.label: Generate Thumbnails
messages.settings.thumbnailing.desc: Generate thumbnails for video listings. It may use a lot of bandwidth, especially in large folders of videos. Turn off if it causes playback problems.
messages.settings.animate.label: Animate Thumbnails
messages.settings.animate.desc: Generate animated thumbnails. Disable this to save bandwidth and IndexedDB cache space.
messages.settings.playlist-depth.label: Playlist folder depth
messages.settings.playlist-depth.desc: How many folder levels to include when adding a folder to the playlist (1 = current folder only).
messages.settings.search-depth.label: Search folder depth
messages.settings.search-depth.desc: How many folder levels to include in the client-side search index (0 = disabled, 1 = current folder only).
messages.settings.cache.label: Thumbnail cache
messages.settings.cache.desc: Amount of IndexedDB space in your browser that is being used to cache thumbnails
messages.settings.export-config.label: Export settings file
messages.settings.export-manifest.label: Export manifest.json
messages.settings.reset.label: Reset to defaults
messages.settings.reset.desc: Reset all settings to their defaults
messages.info.name.name: Filename
messages.info.name.desc: The decoded name of the currently loaded media file.
messages.info.duration.name: Duration
messages.info.duration.desc: The media duration reported by the browser, in seconds.
messages.info.width.name: Width
messages.info.width.desc: The intrinsic video width reported by the media element.
messages.info.height.name: Height
messages.info.height.desc: The intrinsic video height reported by the media element.
messages.info.subtitles.name: Subtitle Tracks
messages.info.subtitles.desc: Number of text tracks currently exposed by the media element.
messages.info.audioTracks.name: Audio Tracks
messages.info.audioTracks.desc: Number of audio tracks currently exposed by the browser, or 1 when track details are unavailable.
messages.info.size.name: Size
messages.info.size.desc: File size from Content-Length, when the server exposes it.
messages.info.mimeType.name: Type
messages.info.mimeType.desc: Content-Type header reported by the server.
messages.info.date.name: Date
messages.info.date.desc: Last-Modified header reported by the server.
messages.info.bitrate.name: Bitrate
messages.info.bitrate.desc: Estimated average bitrate from file size divided by duration.
messages.info.url.name: URL
messages.info.url.desc: The current media URL being played.
messages.info.redirected.name: Redirected
messages.info.redirected.desc: Whether fetch() reports that the media request followed a redirect.
messages.info.corsStatus.name: CORS
messages.info.corsStatus.desc: Outcome of the HEAD metadata request made in CORS mode. Failure does not identify the cause.
messages.info.corsError.name: Metadata request error
messages.info.corsError.desc: Error reported when the HEAD metadata request failed.
messages.info.rangeRequests.name: Range Requests
messages.info.rangeRequests.desc: Result of a small byte-range probe used to check seeking support.
messages.info.rangeError.name: Range Error
messages.info.rangeError.desc: Error reported when the byte-range probe failed.
messages.info.contentEncoding.name: Content-Encoding
messages.info.contentEncoding.desc: HTTP content encoding applied by the server, if any.
messages.info.cacheControl.name: Cache-Control
messages.info.cacheControl.desc: Server cache policy for the media response.
messages.info.etag.name: ETag
messages.info.etag.desc: Server validator used to identify a specific version of the file.
messages.info.mediaError.name: Media Error
messages.info.mediaError.desc: Current HTMLMediaElement error state, if playback failed.
messages.info.readyState.name: Ready State
messages.info.readyState.desc: How much media data the browser currently has ready for playback.
messages.info.networkState.name: Network State
messages.info.networkState.desc: Current network loading state reported by the media element.
messages.info.bufferedRanges.name: Buffered
messages.info.bufferedRanges.desc: Time ranges already buffered by the browser.
messages.info.seekableRanges.name: Seekable
messages.info.seekableRanges.desc: Time ranges the browser can seek within right now.
messages.info.canPlayType.name: canPlayType
messages.info.canPlayType.desc: Browser media engine confidence for the server-reported MIME type.
messages.info.framerate.name: Estimated Framerate
messages.info.framerate.desc: Approximate frame rate measured from requestVideoFrameCallback samples.
messages.info.totalVideoFrames.name: Total Video Frames
messages.info.totalVideoFrames.desc: Total displayed and dropped video frames reported by getVideoPlaybackQuality().
messages.info.droppedVideoFrames.name: Dropped Video Frames
messages.info.droppedVideoFrames.desc: Frames the browser dropped during playback, indicating possible performance pressure.
messages.info.corruptedVideoFrames.name: Corrupted Video Frames
messages.info.corruptedVideoFrames.desc: Frames reported as corrupted by the browser, when available.
messages.info.requestDuration.name: Request Duration
messages.info.requestDuration.desc: Resource timing duration for the media request, when available.
messages.info.transferSize.name: Transfer Size
messages.info.transferSize.desc: Bytes transferred over the network from Resource Timing. Cross-origin values may be hidden.
messages.info.encodedBodySize.name: Encoded Body Size
messages.info.encodedBodySize.desc: Response body size before HTTP content decoding, from Resource Timing. Cross-origin values may require Timing-Allow-Origin.
messages.info.timingNote.name: Timing Note
messages.info.timingNote.desc: Explanation for missing or zeroed Resource Timing details.
messages.info.fullscreenSupport.name: Fullscreen Support
messages.info.fullscreenSupport.desc: Whether this browser exposes the Fullscreen API for this page.
messages.info.pictureInPictureSupport.name: PiP Support
messages.info.pictureInPictureSupport.desc: Whether this browser exposes native Picture-in-Picture for video.
messages.info.wakeLockSupport.name: Wake Lock Support
messages.info.wakeLockSupport.desc: Whether this browser supports preventing screen sleep while playback is active.
messages.info.mediaSessionSupport.name: Media Session Support
messages.info.mediaSessionSupport.desc: Whether this browser supports OS media controls and lock-screen metadata.
messages.info.localFolderSupport.name: Local Folder Support
messages.info.localFolderSupport.desc: Whether this browser supports choosing a local folder with showDirectoryPicker().
messages.info.videoFrameCallbackSupport.name: Video Frame Callback Support
messages.info.videoFrameCallbackSupport.desc: Whether this browser can report per-frame video timing through requestVideoFrameCallback().
messages.ui.import-playlist-from-url-requires-cor: Import playlist from URL (requires CORS support)
messages.ui.add-all-files-from-current-folder: Add playable files from the current folder to the playlist, including subfolders up to the configured depth. Library filters do not limit this action.
messages.ui.no-subtitles-found-in-current-folder: No subtitles found in current folder
messages.ui.drop-player-html-in-a-folder: Drop player.html in a folder of video and audio files and play them on the web
messages.ui.open-local-folder-or-media-file: Open local folder or media file
